info.title: Melete
info.summary: An open-source, self-hosted, model-agnostic personal assistant.
info.description: Give Melete a responsibility, close the tab, come back to progress, a result, or one precise question. This document describes the v0.1 HTTP surface. Nothing here is stable yet: the release is pre-release and endpoints may change until v0.1.0 is tagged.

post.summary: Declare which recalled revisions an output used
post.description: A draft, a plan step or a proposed action names the handles it used. A correction then invalidates exactly the outputs that cited the superseded revision, and an output with an empty manifest is recorded as unattributed and keeps the conservative rule.

post.summary: Report payload values that came from an uncited delivered item
post.description: The check the broker runs before admitting a write_external or spend: any recipient, date, amount or identifier in the payload that appears in a delivered item whose handle is not in the manifest is reported.

post.description: Sets the job to cancelled and bumps the lease epoch. Actions already admitted may still finish; their disposition is recorded honestly and an unknown action is never hidden.

post.summary: Answer a question the job is waiting on

202.description: Accepted; the job is queued for its next attempt

409.description: The job is not waiting for input

post.summary: React to a message with one emoji
post.description: A message is an event, and its id is that event seq. The reaction is persisted and streamed like any other event, and a client draws it on the message bubble rather than as a row of its own. A thumbs-down from a person counts the result it lands on as two unread ones; a thumbs-up clears the unread streak. Reacting twice with the same emoji records one reaction.

409.description: That event is not a message

get.summary: The reactions drawn on one message
Every reaction on one job stream, for a client rendering a transcript
List the attempts of a job
Read one attempt, including the provider and model actually used
Replay and follow one job event stream
get.description: Returns JSON when Accept is application/json and a Server-Sent Events stream when it is text/event-stream. Both start after the `after` cursor; `Last-Event-ID` overrides it.

get.summary: The global feed that drives the inbox
What was repaired on this responsibility, and what stopped safely
get.description: One entry per action that met a typed connector fault: the classes it met, the decisions the repair policy took, and where it came to rest. `completed` is the only disposition that means the effect happened; every other one is a safe stop and `safe_stop` is true. A schema-drift mapping appears as the proposal it is, with the test it had to pass before anything could use it.

get.summary: Read one action with its receipt and reconciliation record

post.summary: Settle an action Melete could not confirm
post.description: Used when verify cannot decide. The owner says what really happened; the answer is recorded as a reconciliation, and the action is never re-dispatched.

post.summary: Claim an admitted in-cell command once using its attempt capability
Settle an in-cell command using the capability of its dispatching attempt
Approve or deny one action
post.description: The decision binds to the payload hash the person was shown. Editing the draft creates a new action, so an approval can never be spent on different content.

409.description: The payload changed since this approval was requested

post.summary: Install a mail, CalDAV, calendar feed or HTTP MCP connection without restarting
post.description: The request carries exactly one configuration block. Secrets are sealed on arrival and never returned. The new connection is tested once; the result is in `check`, and a connection that failed its test stays out of every catalog until a later test passes.

403.description: Space owner and matching audience required

get.summary: List the kinds of connection that can be installed and the fields each needs

post.summary: Test a connection now
post.description: Asks the connector whether its destination answers. The result is a fixed code and sentence; it never carries a transport message, an address or a credential.

get.summary: List the records of one space
get.description: The catalog of the space the caller is bound to. A space id may be repeated as a query argument and must match; it never selects a different space.
Retrieval is scoped to exactly one space by the handle the caller holds, not by a filter argument. Retracted records are never returned.

get.summary: Read one record with its provenance

post.summary: Propose a knowledge write
post.description: The only write path an agent has. The proposal is validated and rendered as a diff the owner applies or discards; applying is a git commit.

get.summary: Retrieve an artifact in the authenticated space
get.description: Returns the recorded bytes only while their hash matches the artifact receipt. Audio can be played directly; a single byte range can be requested for seeking.

schema.description: Artifact id from the action receipt

parameters.description: Artifact id from the action receipt

404.description: No matching artifact in this space

416.description: Requested range is outside the artifact

post.summary: Take human control of a browser session
post.description: Requires the owner session and same-origin protection. The controller increments its epoch before the service parks the job. Already planned inputs are refused.

schema.description: Browser session id returned by browser.observe

parameters.description: Browser session id returned by browser.observe

post.summary: Return browser control to automation
post.description: Requires the owner session and same-origin protection. Increments the control epoch and requires a fresh observation. The job stays parked until owner input.
